summary.intent: Manage the v1.1 milestone's hardening block (phases 51–55) from a single terminal: discuss all 5 phases inline, plan them in parallel using isolated worktrees, and run the complete ship loop (verify → secure → validate → simplify → CodeRabbit → ship) for Phase 51.
summary.outcome: All 5 hardening phases discussed and planned (21 plans total across isolated worktrees). Phase 51 executed and shipped as PR #529 with 5 CodeRabbit zeroization findings fixed; 2 pre-existing Conflict-branch findings deferred to Phase 52 with documented todos.

repo: gsd-tools `init.manager` has two bugs: stale `is_active: true` flag for Phase 50 despite ROADMAP marking it complete, and the dep parser splits 'Phase 49 **(v1.1 baseline)**' into deps 49 + phantom '1.1', causing phases 51–55 to show deps_satisfied: false when they are all unblocked.
`core.hooksPath` is an absolute path pointing to the main tree's `.husky` directory, so all worktrees share the same hooks and each needs its own `node_modules` for lint-staged to run.

`cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` does not compile the desktop crate (`apps/desktop/src-tauri`), allowing cross-crate compile errors from changed public API signatures to slip through the execution gate.
The `winfsp` feature cannot compile on macOS (`winfsp-sys` build script + `windows_core` errors); winfsp-gated changes must rely on CI for Windows build verification.
GSD commit helper auto-switches the shared working tree to a new feature branch on the first commit for a phase — this can pull the tree out from under a concurrently running background agent.

The `#683` auto-degrade in execute-phase fires when the worktree HEAD has diverged from `origin/HEAD`, forcing sequential plan execution in the worktree — beneficial for RAM when planners are running in parallel.
PR titles must follow conventional-commits format (no scope parens for `fix:`) to pass `pr-title.yml` CI; bare `#NN` refs in PR bodies must be escaped to avoid unintended issue links.

Phase 53 research: only 3 stale `release-as` pins exist (`packages/core`, `packages/crypto`, `crates/core`), not the ~8 estimated in the todo; Dependabot `github-actions` block already present (verify-only); native cargo-workspace updater is bugged (upstream issue #2517), fallback is `cargo update --precise` + `git diff --exit-code` guard.

Phase 54 research: `generate-test-vectors.mjs` imports `createIpnsRecord`/`marshalIpnsRecord` from `@cipherbox/crypto` dist, but they actually live in `@cipherbox/core` — a real contract-drift bug the migration will surface at tsc time.

Background agents on Claude Code DO have `Tools: *` including the `Agent` tool (nested subagents work in background); the manager workflow's conservative 'no nesting in background' guardrail is stale for this harness.
GSD commit helper false-negatives `commit_failed` — always verify with `git log` after seeing that result.

Todo #15 (Faro logger redaction) bundled two concerns: `registerFaroTransport` (end-user monitoring, deferred) and logger `redact()` interceptor (secret-leak). Without a remote transport the redaction interceptor only protects the local browser console so its acceptance criteria can't be verified; correctly deferred together.

code.finding: Three byte-identical base64-decode-and-map-err blocks consolidated into a local closure during simplify step.

S3's `unwrap_key` return type change to `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>` cascaded here but the executor's `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` never compiled this crate; caught by the verify step. Fix: store the `Zeroizing` directly (upgraded state field) rather than calling `.to_vec()`.

`root_folder_key` field upgraded from `RwLock<Option<Vec<u8>>>` to `RwLock<Option<Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>>>` to fix CodeRabbit finding #3 (long-lived SDK-state key was downgraded by the `.to_vec()` hotfix).

Folder-key cache type changed from `HashMap<String, Vec<u8>>` to `HashMap<String, Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>>` (CodeRabbit finding #6). `spawn_file_meta_reencrypt` worker's `source_key_arr`/`dest_key_arr` changed from `[u8;32]` to `Zeroizing<[u8;32]>` (finding #7).

Pre-existing bug (introduced Phase 23 / PR #352): Conflict branch on per-file IPNS publish records the sequence as published even on a server 409 Conflict. Deferred to Phase 52 (FUSE durability domain); todo captured.
Same pre-existing Conflict-branch data-integrity bug as macOS operations.rs; deferred to Phase 52 todo.

workflow: For parallel phase work: explicitly create dedicated worktrees per phase (`git worktree add`), run `pnpm install` in each (not a symlink — proper isolated deps), then spawn background agents pointing at the worktree's path via RUNTIME_DIR.

Plan-checker consistently surfaces only doc-marker hygiene findings (RESEARCH `## Open Questions` needs `(RESOLVED)` suffix, VALIDATION.md `nyquist_compliant: false` needs flipping) — these are fixable in-place without a full revision loop.

Optimal ship loop ordering when using CodeRabbit: verify → secure → validate → simplify → CodeRabbit CLI review → fix findings → ship. Running CodeRabbit before `gh pr create` lets the PR open already-clean so `/resolve-pr-reviews` only handles post-create comments.
`git verify-commit` `allowedSignersFile` warning is a local trust-config issue, not a missing SSH signature; CI/GitHub verifies 1Password-signed commits fine.

Background agents cut off mid-flight by session limits often commit their work before stopping; always check the worktree's git log before re-launching rather than assuming the agent needs to restart from scratch.

The execute-in-worktree with auto-degrade (#683) path is validated: when a worktree HEAD diverges from origin/HEAD, execute-phase automatically runs plans sequentially in the worktree using its installed deps — safe and RAM-efficient alongside parallel planners.

Refactoring phases (like Phase 55 decomposing lib.rs into 6 modules) must execute AFTER functional phases that touch the same file (51 S3, 52 replay) are merged to main; otherwise the refactor's 'split this file' commits become impossible to rebase cleanly.
Backgrounded local CodeRabbit CLI re-run writes findings to `.planning/intel/` (gitignored) — this shows as '1 uncommitted change' but is not a real tracked change.

friction: gsd-tools `init.manager` dep-parser bug caused all 5 hardening phases to show `deps_satisfied: false` (phantom '1.1' dep from the baseline annotation), making `recommended_actions` return empty and requiring manual triage.
Background agents launched without `isolation: 'worktree'` operate in the shared main tree — not flagged by the tool, requires the user to notice and set up worktrees manually.

Session/usage limit hit mid-flight twice (8:40pm and 1:40am Berlin), cutting off the Phase 51 planner on first launch and the #1/#2 zeroization fixer before it could report. Both had committed their work but required manual git log verification to confirm.

`cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` gate in execute-phase does not compile cross-crate consumers, allowing a public API signature change (`unwrap_key` return type) to ship with a downstream compile break — caught only by the verify step.

Worktrees share `core.hooksPath` but have no `node_modules` by default; the first commit attempt in a new worktree fails until `pnpm install` runs. Took a symlink attempt + revert before landing on `pnpm install` as the correct approach.
GSD commit helper `commit_failed` false-negative required manual `git log` verification after each commit in the discuss phase — adds friction to every phase capture step.

The manager workflow's 'no nested subagents in background on Claude Code' guardrail is stale/incorrect, leading to an unnecessary debate about background planning quality before the user correctly pushed back with evidence.
